purpose: Corrected-source three-way replication; isolate mutation effort at256 particles from particle count and initial proposal. No accepted sampler or heldout outcome used.
comparison: All original raw score/normalizer/region gates. Additionally each phase-corrected component must agree within3.5 combined whole-population MCSE across both proposal and effort comparisons. Report signed values, all populations, zero masses and preparation/diagnostic costs. Numerical phase identity is qualified for intended continuous F64 law; F32 is not asserted exact.
decision_context: Declared after completed v9 raw and frozen-phase comparisons, before inspecting completed v8 arm aggregate outcomes. Hypothesis is fixed; no adaptive seed/effort tuning.
limitations: This is development only; heldout remains paused.
Support correction fixes missing lower continuous-uniform bound but not a complete mixed-measure finite-RNG law.
Independent pilots are proposal aids; their sampled means are never imposed on posterior estimates.
Initial geometry and proposal fits use only original four independent development pilots.
Future CPU optimization is excluded from this frozen comparison.
